defects_argued.quote: In my view, once, the self-assessed tax as per Section 37 is included in the return furnished under Section 39 of the said Act, Section 75(12) of the said Act can no longer be invoked as is clear from the above explanation.

outcome.quote: With the above observations and directions, the writ petition stands disposed of.

review.notes: OUT OF SCOPE: The challenged determination and recovery were made directly under Section 75(12), not through a Section 73 or Section 74 demand proceeding. The Court held that the authority should initiate the appropriate statutory process, including under Sections 73/74, instead.
